title: RL-ABC: Reinforcement Learning for Accelerator Beamline Control
abstract: arXiv:2604.19146v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Particle accelerator beamline optimization is a high-dimensional control problem traditionally requiring significant expert intervention. We present RLABC (Reinforcement Learning for Accelerator Beamline Control), an open-source Python framework that automatically transforms standard Elegant beamline configurations into reinforcement learning environments. RLABC integrates with the widely-used Elegant beam dynamics simulation code via SDDS-based interfaces, enabling researchers to apply modern RL algorithms to beamline optimization with minimal RL-specific development. translated_title: RL-ABC：基于强化学习的加速器束流线控制
translated_abstract: 粒子加速器束流线优化是一个传统上需要大量专家干预的高维控制问题。我们提出了RLABC（基于强化学习的加速器束流线控制），这是一个开源Python框架，能够自动将标准的Elegant束流线配置转换为强化学习环境。RLABC通过基于SDDS的接口与广泛使用的Elegant束流动力学模拟代码集成，使研究人员能够以最少的强化学习专用开发工作，将现代强化学习算法应用于束流线优化。其主要贡献是一种将束流线调谐形式化为马尔可夫决策过程的通用方法：RLABC自动预处理晶格文件，在每个可调元件之前插入诊断监视点，从束流统计、协方差信息和孔径约束构建57维状态表示，并提供可配置的……
tldr: 该论文提出了开源Python框架RL-ABC，可将Elegant束流线配置自动转换为强化学习环境，并提供了将束流线调谐形式化为马尔可夫决策过程的通用方法，使研究人员能以极少的强化学习开发工作量将现代强化学习算法应用于加速器束流线优化。
en_tdlr: This paper presents RL-ABC, an open-source Python framework that automatically transforms Elegant beamline configurations into reinforcement learning environments and provides a general methodology for formulating beamline tuning as a Markov decision process, enabling researchers to apply modern RL algorithms to accelerator beamline optimization with minimal development effort.
